headline: China issues a recommended technical standard for large-model inference platforms
summary: China's national standards catalogue records YD/T 7171—2026 as a recommended communications industry standard for large-model inference platforms, published on 2026-07-15 and effective from 2026-11-01. Its stated scope covers model compression, deployment, inference, platform services and management and provides functional reference for institutions using such platforms. The catalogue does not establish mandatory adoption, organization-level compliance or measured implementation outcomes.
